regime_context: Detector shows a narrow high-dividend/defensive leadership with no scorable ETF proxies — momentum is best read as attention where 35% of themes are eligible, and the headline HK dividend theme has high durability but is itself unscorable. Given no scorable themes exist except deeply negative China Tech (3033.HK) and China Platform Megacaps (3033.HK), and the only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control rather than return forecasting, most directional theses are unsupported. The small sample (n=10) of the track record lowers confidence despite its perfect hit rate.
emerging_watch: Watch China Tech & Internet (3033.HK) for a CONFIRMED improvement in eligibility — currently score -0.778, durability 0.17, breadth 0.211, mean-revert Hurst — which would only become watchable if breadth expands above ~0.6 and score turns positive on no crowding. The watch retires if the theme falls another 5% relative to Hang Seng over the next 10 sessions.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: The HK dividend theme is the headline narrative with the highest durability (0.85), full breadth (1.0), trend-positive Hurst tag, and no crowding. It is the only eligible leadership with a long-standing, trend-healthy structure. The lean relies on the trend-gate edge (staying power/drawdown control) rather than momentum rank, and it is a direction, not a size.
evidence: eligible = true, trend-gate is the validated risk-control leg
theses.dissent: High-dividend leadership may simply reflect risk-off defensiveness rather than absolute out-performance; breadthy defensive demand can stall quickly when the macro narrative (ai_tech/geopolitics, unscheduled share 0.95) shifts risk appetite back on.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips fail to hold positive 10-day relative performance versus Hang Seng by the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
